Name: Connected Fences
Author: sergiomadd
Description:
[size=5]Requirements:[/size]
- [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility:[/size]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.4+ on Windows in single-player.
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JA[/url] 1.9.1 on Windows in single-player.

Still not tested in: Linux/macOS both single-player and multiplayer.
If you can test the mod in those platforms please feel free to message me with the feedback.

[size=5]Credits:[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9629]JA - Mermaid Fence[/url] from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/126403508]lindenmori[/url] for testing JA compatibility.
